params.prompt: [Static shot] The technician faces the camera in front view. He lowers smoothly onto one knee with his elbows tucked beside his ribs and his hands held quietly near his waist. Only after his knee touches the ground, he reaches forward a short distance to repair a low panel, then brings his hands back to his waist and rises smoothly. Preserve the reference slim body, goggles, moustache, dark neutral graphite suit and muted yellow patches. Fixed camera, full body visible, plain green background.
